title: polystichum munitum subsp. nudatum
intro: Polystichum munitum subsp. nudatum, commonly known as Western sword fern, is a subspecies of the Polystichum munitum species, a type of evergreen fern native to the Pacific coast of North America. The Western sword fern is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. Its therapeutic actions are believed to include antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-cancer effects, although more research is needed to confirm these properties. The bioactive constituents of Western sword fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
